title: Task 1: Add rules-pack metadata and license validation
description:
Objective:
Create the provider-neutral rules-pack type model and validation boundary used by every later task.

Files:
- Create: `packages/core/src/rules/types.ts`
- Create: `packages/core/src/rules/validate.ts`
- Create: `packages/core/src/rules/license.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/rulesPack.test.ts`

Steps:
1. Write failing tests in `packages/core/test/rulesPack.test.ts` for valid base pack metadata, invalid blank `systemId`, invalid addon without compatibility, duplicate record keys within one pack, explicit license fields, and user-private policy rejection at shippable boundaries.
2. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/rulesPack.test.ts`; expected: FAIL because `validateRulesPack` and related exports do not exist.
3. Add `RulesPack`, `RulesPackMeta`, `RulesPackRole`, `RulesRecord`, `RulesRecordKind`, `RulesPackLicense`, and `RulesPackError` in `packages/core/src/rules/types.ts`.
4. Implement `validateRulesPack(value)` in `packages/core/src/rules/validate.ts` using the existing `world/validate.ts` style: structural checks, non-empty strings, role enum, license checks, unique record keys per pack, addon compatibility declarations.
5. Implement `evaluateRulesPackPolicy` and `assertShippableRulesPack` in `packages/core/src/rules/license.ts`, reusing the same policy semantics as `world/license.ts`.
6. Export the new rules APIs from `packages/core/src/index.ts`.
7. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/rulesPack.test.ts`; expected: PASS.
8. Commit with `git add packages/core/src/rules packages/core/src/index.ts packages/core/test/rulesPack.test.ts` and `git commit -m feat-rules-pack-validation-model`.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run packages/core/test/rulesPack.test.ts` passes. New rules-pack APIs are exported from the package barrel. Validation rejects malformed metadata, duplicate keys, addon packs without compatibility declarations, and unshippable licenses at shippable boundaries.
notes: Spec review found a required fix after premature close: validateRulesPack must reject rules records missing required data, and rulesPack tests must cover that case before code-quality review.
close_reason: Implemented rules-pack metadata, validation, license wrappers, exports, and focused tests; spec and code-quality reviews passed; verification: focused vitest and forced tsc passed.
